concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a refined design exploration board for Prism, a minimalist collaborative document workspace. Brand metaphor MUST be many colored light beams entering a central glasslike geometric prism from the LEFT, uniting into exactly ONE ray exiting to the RIGHT. Never draw a single input splitting into a rainbow output. Premium precise vector-like geometry, restrained spectrum of violet blue teal amber coral, graphite silhouette and warm ivory background. No blurry glow, no generic AI sparkle, no decorative cube. A main full-spectrum mark with the word Prism, and below smaller compact and monochrome variations that preserve the many-in/one-out structure. Show a quiet charcoal app tile variation and compact navigation wordmark. Exact headings only: Prism; Many sources. One workspace.; Full spectrum; Compact; Monochrome. White outgoing ray on charcoal, graphite outgoing ray on ivory. Plenty of white space. This is a brand concept board, not a production vector export. High resolution landscape.

Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity software UI design board for Prism, a calm minimalist collaborative workspace. Two views: a large desktop document-with-agent screen occupying 75% of board and a narrow mobile view on the right. Warm gray sidebar #f5f5f3, white paper surface, graphite #25262a text, restrained blue interactive accents, Inter-style sans serif, precise 1px borders, restrained 8px radii. Flat front-on screens, no physical device, no decorative backdrop, no glassmorphism. Brand at upper left: tiny spectrum beams entering geometric prism from left and exactly one output ray right, word Prism. Desktop left navigation Search, Notes, Inbox, Calendar, Tasks, People, then Favorites and Tools. Current doc title 'A living workspace', quiet header breadcrumb Projects / Prism, saved status, collaborator avatar Mira, Share, Agent. Main writing text 'A shared place to think, write, and build with the same context.' Sections Purpose, Principles, Next steps. Agent sidebar about 360px wide with header Agent and working document A living workspace. A permission dropdown is OPEN with exactly these three options: 'Read-only', 'Suggested edits only', 'Read/write'. Read/write has a selected check. Tiny sentence 'Applies to this conversation'. Conversation You: 'Tighten the introduction using our project notes.' Agent: 'I updated the introduction and kept the ownership principle.' Compact activity 'Edited introduction' and link 'View change'. Two source pills Workspace principles and Field notes. Composer 'Continue the conversation…', Add context and a send icon. Do not invent external sends or giant approval buttons. Mobile screen shows same document title, segmented Document / Agent with Agent selected, identical Read/write permission selector collapsed, readable conversation and bottom composer. Fictional people and data only. This is a design concept, not an implemented app screenshot. Prioritize readable labels and generous useful space.
